blocks.text: Maple Ridge houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of houses in Maple Ridge peaked at 472 in September 2025 and bottomed at 313 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in July 2026 with 60. The reported sale price moved from $1,190,000 to $1,131,000, a change of −5.0%.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends

faq.q: Which Maple Ridge sub-area had the strongest sales ratio in September 2026?
faq.a: On detached homes, Websters Corners at 25% — but that is 2 sales on 8 listings, so treat it with a small-count caution; Southwest's 22% rests on 9 sales and 41 listings. On Condos & Townhomes, Southwest led at 38% (3 sales on 8 listings, also a small count), ahead of Albion at 22% (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: When are property taxes due on a Maple Ridge home?
faq.a: To the City of Maple Ridge: property taxes are due on the first business day in July, which for 2026 was July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on balances outstanding after the due date and a further 5% on balances still outstanding around September 1–2, 2026.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 410 houses listed in Maple Ridge and 40 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The September report gave $1,131,000 for houses in Maple Ridge, against $1,195,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The September report showed 29 days on market for houses in Maple Ridge and a sale-to-list price ratio of 97%, against 31 days the month before.
